name: TVApp2
description: Automatic M3U playlist and XML guide updater for TheTvApp, TVPass, and MoveOnJoy utilized within your IPTV client. GitHub Project: https://github.com/TheBinaryNinja/tvapp2

variables.name: Internal Server IP
variables.description: IP to use for webserver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Server Port
variables.description: Port to use for webserver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Data Files Source
variables.description: Determines where the data files will be downloaded from. Do not change this or you will be unable to get M3U and EPG data.

variables.name: Internal Build Directory
variables.description: Directory to build the app in. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Run Directory
variables.description: Directory to run the app in. Not recommended to change.
